messages.content: "Could you please help me with the following tasks? First, I need to know the travel distance and estimated travel time from my home in New York to my office in Boston, considering the current traffic conditions. Second, I am interested in finding out the top 5 chess players in San Francisco with a minimum rating of 2500. Lastly, I am working on a project and need to retrieve the historical GDP data for Japan from the year 2000 to 2020. Can you assist me with these?"

function.name: board_game_chess_get_top_players
function.description: Find top chess players in a location based on rating. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city you want to find the players from.

minimum_rating.description: Minimum rating to filter the players.

number_of_players.description: Number of players you want to retrieve, default value is 10

function.name: get_historical_GDP
function.description: Retrieve historical GDP data for a specific country and time range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which the historical GDP data is required.

start_year.description: Starting year of the period for which GDP data is required.

end_year.description: Ending year of the period for which GDP data is required.

function.name: maps_get_distance_duration
function.description: Retrieve the travel distance and estimated travel time from one location to another via car Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

traffic.description: If true, considers current traffic. Default is false.

3) Historical GDP data for Japan 2000-2020.

Second request uses board_game_chess_get_top_players; location="San Francisco", minimum_rating=2500, number_of_players=5.

Third request uses get_historical_GDP; country="Japan", start_year=2000, end_year=2020.
